literal: Wealth we lost saying they will not grieve energy firmly in hand those who possess.
translation: Those who hold unfailing energy in their hands will not grieve, saying, "We have lost our wealth."
modern: ஊக்கத்தை உறுதியாகத் தம் கைவசம் உடையவர்கள், "நம் செல்வத்தை இழந்துவிட்டோமே" என்று எண்ணி வருந்த மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that inner drive is more valuable than material wealth. The word 'ūkkam' denotes a relentless energy or motivation, while 'ākkam' refers to acquired wealth or prosperity. Those who possess this energy 'firmly in hand' (oruvantam kaittu) know they can always rebuild what they have lost. Therefore, they do not fall into despair when they lose their material possessions.
